So he{CLEAR}held an open selection and appointed{CLEAR}me as the new Violet Gym Leader.{SCROLL}Falkner: I remember Verdell{NEWLINE}even came to congratulate me when I{CLEAR}took the post. strings.zh: 阿速『嗯,绿色宝珠是从我手上弄丢的,{NEWLINE}就算是死我也要把宝珠找回来！
strings.en: Falkner: Yes. The Jade Orb{NEWLINE}was lost on my watch. I’ll get{CLEAR}it back even if it kills me!
